seeds.why: Pre-#1264 _over_retired_chunks: a retired chunk's bound with no offset (a pre-#977 strategy's covered_hi, kept verbatim) is read in the caller's TimeZone, so the same call holds a partition from pg_cron's UTC session and not from an operator's Asia/Kolkata one, which then archives it over the retired range. One site, the zone the bounds are read in. tests/334 parts B to E catch it.
